Dungeon Event.name: Dungeon Event
Dungeon Event.description: The Warden rolls on this table when the party spends more than one dungeon cycle in a single room or location, moves quickly or haphazardly through a room, moves into a new area, level, or zone, or creates a loud disturbance.

1-1.name: Encounter
1-1.description: Roll on an encounter table. Possibly hostile. (See Reactions.)

2-2.name: Sign
2-2.description: A clue, spoor, track, abandoned lair, scent, victim, etc is discovered.

3-3.name: Environment
3-3.description: Surroundings shift or escalate. Water rises, ceilings collapse, a ritual nears completion, etc.

4-4.name: Loss
4-4.description: Torches are blown out, an ongoing spell fizzles, etc. The party must resolve the effect before moving on.

5-5.name: Exhaustion
5-5.description: The party must rest (triggering another roll on this table), add a Fatigue, or consume a ration.

6-6.name: Quiet
6-6.description: The party is left alone (and safe) for the time being.

Faction Advantage Count.name: Faction Advantage Count
Faction Advantage Count.description: Roll the number of Advantages a faction has, then roll Faction Advantage that many times (reroll repeats).

Faction Advantage.name: Faction Advantage
Faction Advantage.description: Roll the Advantage column of the Faction Advantages table.

Faction Agenda.name: Faction Agenda
Faction Agenda.description: Roll the Agenda column of the Faction Agendas table.

Faction Agent.name: Faction Agent
Faction Agent.description: Roll the Agent column of the Faction Types table — a faction's representative.

Faction Name Formula.name: Faction Name Formula
Faction Name Formula.description: Roll the Faction Names Formula table of the Naming Procedures; [Group] is a roll on Group Type.

Faction Obstacle.name: Faction Obstacle
Faction Obstacle.description: Roll the Obstacle column of the Faction Agendas table.

1-1.description: A geographic barrier or impassable terrain.

2-2.description: A key piece of information must first be discovered.

3-3.description: A particular object or Relic is required.

4-4.description: A powerful figure or foe must be eliminated.

5-5.description: A rare but necessary resource must first be acquired.

6-6.description: A serious debt forces the faction to make dire choices.

7-7.description: A well-known prophecy predicts imminent failure.

8-8.description: An alliance with an enemy must first be brokered.

9-9.description: An internal schism threatens to tear the faction apart.

10-10.description: Another faction has the same goal.

14-14.description: Contravenes an established code, with a heavy penalty.

16-16.description: Many must die, either as a necessity or consequence.

17-17.description: Must be carried out at a rare or exact moment.

18-18.description: Must be carried out in absolute secrecy.

19-19.description: Requires a specialist of an uncommon sort.

20-20.description: The outcome would lead to unavoidable war.

Faction Trait 1.name: Faction Trait 1
Faction Trait 1.description: Roll the Trait 1 column of the Faction Traits table.

Faction Trait 2.name: Faction Trait 2
Faction Trait 2.description: Roll the Trait 2 column of the Faction Traits table.

Faction Type.name: Faction Type
Faction Type.description: Roll the Type column of the Faction Types table.

Forest Adjective.name: Forest Adjective
Forest Adjective.description: Roll the Adjectives column of the Forest Names table of the Naming Procedures.

Forest Noun.name: Forest Noun
Forest Noun.description: Roll the Nouns column of the Forest Names table of the Naming Procedures.

Group Type.name: Group Type
Group Type.description: Roll the Group Types table of the Naming Procedures.

Monster Ability Target.name: Monster Ability Target
Monster Ability Target.description: Roll the Target column of the Monster Abilities table.

Monster Ability.name: Monster Ability
Monster Ability.description: Roll the Ability column of the Monster Abilities table.

Monster Attack.name: Monster Attack
Monster Attack.description: Roll the Type column of the Monster Attacks table.

Monster Category.name: Monster Category
Monster Category.description: Roll a monster Group, then pick or roll one of the listed 2e bestiary monsters.

2-2.name: Beast
2-2.description: Blood Elk, Grizzly Bear, Killer Bees, Night Cat, Viper, Wolf

7-7.name: Fey
7-7.description: Boggart, Dryad, Frost Elf, Pixie, Red Cap, Night Hag, Sea Hag, Will-o-Wisp

9-9.name: Goblinoid
9-9.description: Bugbear, Goblin, Hobgoblin, Ogre, Root Goblin, Troll, Wood Troll

13-13.name: Insectoid
13-13.description: Aranea, Burrowing Horror, Cave Locust, Giant Scorpion

17-17.name: Plant
17-17.description: Creeping Vines, Root Witch, Shambling Mound, Treant

19-19.name: Undead
19-19.description: Crypt Guardian, Ghost, Ghoul, Lich, Mummy, Skeleton, Vampire, Wight, Zombie

20-20.name: Unusual
20-20.description: Gelatinous Ooze, Mimic, Rust Monster, Warrior Snail

Monster Critical Damage.name: Monster Critical Damage
Monster Critical Damage.description: Roll the Critical Damage column of the Monster Attacks table.

Monster Feature.name: Monster Feature
Monster Feature.description: Roll the Feature column of the Monster Appearance table.

Monster Physique.name: Monster Physique
Monster Physique.description: Roll the Physique column of the Monster Appearance table.

Monster Quirk.name: Monster Quirk
Monster Quirk.description: Roll the Quirks column of the Monster Traits table.

5-5.description: Does Not Die of Old Age

Monster Weakness.name: Monster Weakness
Monster Weakness.description: Roll the Weakness column of the Monster Traits table.

Name Adjective.name: Name Adjective
Name Adjective.description: Roll the Adjectives table of the Naming Procedures.

Name Formula.name: Name Formula
Name Formula.description: Roll the Names Formula table of the Naming Procedures for a point of interest; [POI] is the kind of place.

Name Noun.name: Name Noun
Name Noun.description: Roll the Nouns table of the Naming Procedures.

NPC Background.name: NPC Background
NPC Background.description: Roll the NPC's Background. Their starting gear is resolved by the generator, not this table.

NPC Goal.name: NPC Goal
NPC Goal.description: Roll what an NPC is trying to achieve.

NPC Name.name: NPC Name
NPC Name.description: Roll a Name for an NPC. The three source lists are merged here into one d60.

NPC Quirk.name: NPC Quirk
NPC Quirk.description: Roll a physical or behavioural Quirk for an NPC.

Ruler Name Formula.name: Ruler Name Formula
Ruler Name Formula.description: Roll the Ruler Names Formula table of the Naming Procedures; [Rulers] is a roll on Ruler Type.

Ruler Type.name: Ruler Type
Ruler Type.description: Roll the Ruler Types table of the Naming Procedures.

Terrain Synonym.name: Terrain Synonym
Terrain Synonym.description: The Terrain Synonyms table of the Naming Procedures, one result per synonym. It has no die of its own: the name generator picks among the synonyms of the chosen terrain.

Vald Weather (Dead).name: Vald Weather (Dead)
Vald Weather (Dead).description: Roll the Dead column of the Weather in Vald table for a day of the Dead season. It describes the day; the weather a journey travels in is the Journey's own roll.

Vald Weather (Dry).name: Vald Weather (Dry)
Vald Weather (Dry).description: Roll the Dry column of the Weather in Vald table for a day of the Dry season. It describes the day; the weather a journey travels in is the Journey's own roll.

Vald Weather (Harvest).name: Vald Weather (Harvest)
Vald Weather (Harvest).description: Roll the Harvest column of the Weather in Vald table for a day of the Harvest season. It describes the day; the weather a journey travels in is the Journey's own roll.

Vald Weather (Wet).name: Vald Weather (Wet)
Vald Weather (Wet).description: Roll the Wet column of the Weather in Vald table for a day of the Wet season. It describes the day; the weather a journey travels in is the Journey's own roll.

Wilderness Encounter.name: Wilderness Encounter
Wilderness Encounter.description: A generic table of common wild creatures. Each result links a 2e bestiary Actor; the description leads with how many appear.

Wilderness Event.name: Wilderness Event
Wilderness Event.description: The Warden rolls once on this table after each Wilderness Action (twice at night).

1-1.name: Encounter
1-1.description: Roll on an encounter table for that terrain type or location. Don’t forget to roll for NPC reactions if applicable.

2-2.name: Sign
2-2.description: The party discovers a clue, spoor, or indication of a nearby encounter, locality, hidden feature, or information about a nearby area.

4-4.name: Loss
4-4.description: The party is faced with a choice that costs them a resource (rations, tools, etc), time, or effort.

5-5.name: Exhaustion
5-5.description: The party encounters a barrier, forcing effort, care or delays. This might mean spending extra time (and an additional Wilderness Action) or adding Fatigue to the PC's inventory to represent their difficulties.

6-6.name: Discovery
6-6.description: The party finds food, treasure, or other useful resources. The Warden can instead choose to reveal the primary feature of the area.
